notes: Updates from Diastema support: when your server is connected to Diastema, Diastema support can now install an update for you (usually overnight, at the install time in Settings → About), go back to an earlier version if an update causes trouble, and adjust your update settings. Settings → About shows anything scheduled and who installed the last update. As always, only updates signed by Diastema are installed, your data is backed up first, and the previous version is put back automatically if a new one doesn't start.
